newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Jan-May imports, exports rise.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Jan-May imports, exports rise.

text.p: Cyprus's imports and exports rose 16.3 and 27.5 percent respectively between January and May this year compared to the corresponding period in 1995, the island's statistics department said on Friday.
It said total imports rose to 801.3 million pounds ($1.739 billion) between January and May this year compared to imports worth 689 million pounds in the first five months of 1995.
The figure covers imports for home consumption and imports placed into bonded warehouses.
Total exports amounted to 272.2 million pounds from January to May compared to 213.5 million pounds in the same period in 1995.

Domestic exports including shipstores fell to 103.8 million in January to May in comparison to 108.5 million in January to May 1995, but re-exports including shipstores rose sharply to 168.4 million from 105.1 million in January to May 1995.
European Union countries absorbed 61.2 percent of domestic exports, followed by Arab countries with a 17 percent share.
Industrial products made locally accounted for 65.1 percent of all exports.
